title: CRM tables keep names, dates and amounts whole and pin the first and Actions columns
text: Many CRM tables used to split words over several lines or hide columns when the window was narrow. Names, dates, amounts, status chips and e-mails now stay on one line, and the first column and the Actions column stay pinned while you scroll sideways. It was done in three rounds: Finance All Invoices, Invoice aging and My Finances; then Bank applications, Marketing Money and Audit log, Cases, Catalog, Team management, Referrals, Workflows and Fax history; then Portal launch, Teams, Partners, Client health and Tasks.
points: Euro amounts keep their euro sign whole.
Only the layout changed; no data or behaviour.
